title: tools\build\build.ps1 puts native intermediates inside project folders, bloating context-menu MSIX packages

judgment.rationale: The issue is directly covered by an open upstream fix PR and an open fork review mirror. This is existing fix coverage, not a resolution of the still-open issue.
evidence: Upstream PR #51321 explicitly closes #51318 and describes passing the appropriate SolutionDir when building a single project: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51321
MuyuanMS/PowerToys mirror PR #1046 is open on branch pr-iterate/51321: https://github.com/MuyuanMS/PowerToys/pull/1046
Current upstream build.ps1 forwards supplied extra arguments; build-essentials.ps1 supplies SolutionDir, and the PowerRename context-menu project uses SolutionDir for its intermediate directory.
judgment.recommended_action: Reuse and follow PR #51321 and its existing fork mirror; do not create a competing fix or design. Keep the issue open until upstream work resolves it.

fix_assessment.rationale: Upstream PR #51321 (OPEN; updated 2026-10-15T06:37:27Z) explicitly closes this issue and changes build.ps1/build-common.ps1 to resolve and pass SolutionDir. The existing MuyuanMS/PowerToys mirror PR #1046 (OPEN; updated 2026-10-18T18:54:59Z) is branch pr-iterate/51321. Links: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51321 and https://github.com/MuyuanMS/PowerToys/pull/1046. Do not duplicate this work.

issue_context.summary: A standalone project build reportedly places native intermediates in the project directory, which then inflates a context-menu MSIX. An open upstream PR and fork mirror already target this behavior.
known_information: The issue reports a single-project build, a clean expected project directory, and an oversized MSIX containing many intermediate files.
The issue has one automated triage comment and no substantive follow-up; no issue attachments were present.
Upstream PR #51321 explicitly says it closes this issue; the fork mirror #1046 remains open.
inferences: The open PRs likely address the reported cause, but the issue is not resolved until the upstream PR is merged and the fix is available.
issue_context.analysis: Current upstream script and project evidence match the issue's SolutionDir explanation. The linked PR already supplies the fix and a reported validation path, so another design would duplicate active work.
initial_investigation: Reviewed current upstream tools/build/build.ps1 and build-essentials.ps1: the latter supplies SolutionDir while the standalone script forwards caller-provided arguments.
Reviewed the PowerRenameContextMenu project intermediate-directory property, which is rooted at SolutionDir.
Reviewed upstream PR #51321 and its open MuyuanMS/PowerToys mirror PR #1046; both cover this issue. PR validation is author-reported and was not independently rerun.
